thread: Monica: Quick design review — table row actions on the Console: should we keep inline pencil/delete icons visible on hover, or collapse them into a single kebab overflow? Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/xyz (see 'row-actions v4'). Sam: I prefer overflow for dense rows, but inline icons are quicker for power users. tradeoff is visual noise. Arun: Important for keyboard users — if actions are hover-only we need a visible focus target. Right now tabbing lands on the row but not the actions. Jen: +1 on accessibility. If we keep inline icons, we should ensure they have aria-labels and 44px hit area. Also needs clear focus ring. Monica: Good call. Current mock uses 24px icons with 8px padding (total 40px). Is that enough? Sam: 40px is borderline. Mobile guidelines want 44px. I'd standardize on spacing tokens so we don't have ad-hoc values. Arun: Related: when text overflows we show ellipsis. If the overflow causes the actions to wrap or compress, the inline icons get hidden. We need a reliable layout: actions anchored to the right so ellipsis never hide them. Jen: So rules: 1) actions always visible at row end, 2) ellipsis applied to primary cell up to the actions boundary, 3) keyboard focus should move to actions after row. Monica: Proto idea: render actions absolutely positioned inside the cell container with a fixed width (e.g., 88px for two icons + spacing). Then main text gets a CSS max-width and text-overflow: ellipsis. Thoughts? Sam: That works. Might need to adapt width for responsive breakpoints — on narrow screens switch to overflow menu only. Arun: Accessibility nit: the kebab menu and pencil need meaningful labels. e.g., aria-label="Edit rule" and aria-haspopup="true" for the menu. Also provide visually hidden text for screen readers for the ellipsized content: Full name: Awesome long rule name .... Jen: UX copy: tooltip for pencil should be 'Edit' not 'Edit row' to match other places. Kebab menu tooltip should be 'More actions'. Keep tooltips consistent. Monica: I'll update Figma and send an updated flow. Also want to test animation for hover reveal — avoid layout shift. Maybe use opacity transform instead of changing layout. Sam: Agree — don't change reflow. Use transform translateX(0) and opacity. Arun: Quick CSS mock: ``` .row-cell { position: relative; } .row-actions { position: absolute; right: 8px; top: 50%; transform: translateY(-50%); width: 88px; display: flex; gap: var(--space-2); } .row-content { padding-right: 96px; /* ensure space for actions */ overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; } ``` Jen: Looks good. But be careful with variable token names: var(--space-2) maps to 8px in current tokens, confirm with design tokens team. DesignBot: Reminder: accessibility checklist updated — focusable controls must be >= 44x44, aria-labels present, and keyboard order logical. See /docs/a11y-checklist. Monica: Plan: I'll produce two variants by tomorrow: (A) inline icons with accessible focus and fixed action width, (B) overflow-only for mobile-first. We'll run quick playtest with screen reader and keyboard. Sam: Thanks — also flag to eng: when you hand off please include a small migration note for any spacing token changes. Arun: One more thought — toast behaviour after delete: small confirmation toast with Undo action should appear anchored to bottom-right of table, not center. Align copy: 'Rule deleted — Undo'. Jen: +1 on copy. Keep toast auto-dismiss 6s, include role="status" for screen readers. Monica: Great. I'll update Figma and follow up in this thread with screenshots and a short checklist. :thumbsup:
